findings.description: render_finish applies the pending remainder via make_step and render_progress even when hidden or when the bar was already finished. This also runs when the loop is aborted early, e.g. on break or an exception.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a progress bar with update_min_steps>1 whose iteration exits early via break or an exception. The pending sub-threshold steps are added to pos, so the final render shows a position that was never completed, and 'finished' may be set spuriously. The remainder is applied unconditionally, before the hidden/non-tty check, so extra work also happens for hidden bars. In non-tty mode render_progress is harmless, but the pos/eta state still gets altered.
